en.p: Two points $\mathrm{P}$ and $\mathrm{Q}$ start at time $t=0$ from points $\mathrm{A}(1)$ and $\mathrm{B}(8)$, respectively, and move along a number line. The velocities of $\mathrm{P}$ and $\mathrm{Q}$ at time $t\ (t\ge 0)$ are
respectively. What is the distance traveled by point $\mathrm{P}$ from the start until the distance between $\mathrm{P}$ and $\mathrm{Q}$ first becomes $4$? [4 points]
